# GLASS paired GBM COL analysis

We hypothesize that when comparing primary and recurrent GBM, COLI and III expression will be upregulated in recurrent GBM. 

## Libraries
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install("EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75")
BiocManager::install("edgeR")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(tidyverse)
```

## DE Analysis

Building Meta data from GLSS sample IDs

```{r}

# Rebuild metadata fresh from the current count matrix
sample_ids <- colnames(counts_tx)

# Use regex to pull out site, patient, and tumor code
# Pattern: GLSS-<SITE>-<PATIENT>-(TP or R1/R2/...)- 
m <- str_match(sample_ids, "^GLSS-([A-Z0-9]{2})-([A-Z0-9]+)-(TP|R[0-9]+)-")

meta2 <- tibble(
  sample_id  = sample_ids,
  site       = m[, 2],                                   # e.g. "19", "CU", "HF"
  patient_id = m[, 3],                                   # raw patient code, can start with letter
  patient    = ifelse(is.na(m[, 2]) | is.na(m[, 3]),
                      NA_character_,
                      paste0("GLSS-", m[, 2], "-", m[, 3])),  # full patient ID
  tumor_code = m[, 4],                                   # "TP", "R1", "R2", etc.
  tumor_type = case_when(
    tumor_code == "TP"             ~ "Primary",
    str_detect(tumor_code, "^R")   ~ "Recurrent",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
)

# Look at what we got
head(meta2)
table(meta2$tumor_type, useNA = "ifany")
sum(is.na(meta2$patient))

```

```{r}
## Add sample_barcode combining patient and tumor_code

meta2 <- meta2 %>%
  mutate(
    sample_barcode = ifelse(
      is.na(patient) | is.na(tumor_code),
      NA_character_,
      paste0(patient, "-", tumor_code)
    )
  )

# Quick check
head(meta2 %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, patient, tumor_code, sample_barcode))

```
### Filter IDH-WT GBM
```{r}
## Filter meta2 to only Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype using sample_barcode

# 1) Load clinical_surgeries
clin <- read.delim(
  file.path(glass_dir, "clinical_surgeries.tsv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 2) Standardize names
names(clin) <- tolower(names(clin))

# 3) Get the list of sample_barcodes that are GBM, IDH-wildtype
gbm_barcodes <- clin %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(who_classification),
    who_classification == "Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype"
  ) %>%
  pull(sample_barcode) %>%
  unique()

length(gbm_barcodes)  # how many GBM IDH-wt samples exist?

# 4) Subset meta2 to ONLY those barcodes
meta2 <- meta2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_barcode %in% gbm_barcodes)

# 5) Sanity checks
nrow(meta2)
length(unique(meta2$patient))
table(meta2$tumor_type, useNA = "ifany")

```

Filtering data to only include paired samples. 
```{r}
## Filter to non-NA tumor_type and build paired GBM, IDH-wt set

# 1) Drop samples without a tumor_type
meta2_clean <- meta2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tumor_type))

table(meta2_clean$tumor_type)

# 2) Identify patients with BOTH Primary and Recurrent
paired_patients <- meta2_clean %>%
  group_by(patient) %>%
  summarise(n_types = n_distinct(tumor_type), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_types == 2) %>%
  pull(patient)

length(paired_patients)  # number of truly paired GBM IDH-wt patients

# 3) Keep only samples from those paired patients
meta_paired2 <- meta2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(patient %in% paired_patients)

# 4) Subset counts to those samples
counts_tx2 <- counts_tx[, meta_paired2$sample_id]

# 5) Align metadata order to count matrix columns
meta_paired2 <- meta_paired2[match(colnames(counts_tx2), meta_paired2$sample_id), ]

# 6) Sanity checks
table(meta_paired2$tumor_type)
length(unique(meta_paired2$patient))
all(colnames(counts_tx2) == meta_paired2$sample_id)

```

Build transcript for gene mapping and clean ENST ID
```{r}

## Transcript → gene mapping and aggregation to gene level

edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75

# 1) Transcript → gene mapping from EnsDb
tx_annot <- transcripts(
  edb,
  columns = c("tx_id", "gene_name"),
  return.type = "DataFrame"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", tx_id)   # drop version suffix
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(tx_id_clean, gene_name) %>%
  distinct()

# 2) Clean GLASS transcript IDs in the paired count matrix
counts_tbl <- counts_tx2 %>%
  rownames_to_column("raw_tx") %>%
  mutate(
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\|.*$", "", raw_tx),       # drop anything after '|'
    tx_id_clean = sub("\\..*$", "", tx_id_clean)   # drop version suffix
  )

# 3) Join counts with annotation
merged <- inner_join(counts_tbl, tx_annot, by = "tx_id_clean")

nrow(merged)
length(unique(merged$gene_name))

# 4) Aggregate transcript counts → gene-level counts for paired samples
sample_cols <- colnames(counts_tx2)

counts_gene_paired2 <- merged %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ sum(as.numeric(.))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Diagnostics
dim(counts_gene_paired2)
head(counts_gene_paired2[, 1:5])
summary(as.numeric(counts_gene_paired2))

```
#### Run limma
```{r}
## --- limma-voom paired differential expression: Recurrent vs Primary ---

# 1) Ensure metadata is properly typed
meta_paired2 <- meta_paired2 %>%
  mutate(
    patient    = factor(patient),
    tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent"))
  )

# 2) Build DGEList from gene-level paired counts
y <- DGEList(counts = counts_gene_paired2)

# 3) Filter out ultra-lowly expressed genes
keep <- rowSums(y$counts) >= 10
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# 4) TMM normalization
y <- calcNormFactors(y)

# 5) Design matrix: patient (paired blocking term) + tumor_type (effect of interest)
design <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor_type, data = meta_paired2)

# 6) Voom transformation
v <- voom(
  y,
  design,
  plot = FALSE
)

# 7) Fit linear model
fit <- lmFit(v, design)

# 8) Empirical Bayes shrinkage
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# 9) Extract differential expression results (Recurrent vs Primary)
limma_res <- topTable(
  fit,
  coef   = "tumor_typeRecurrent",  # logFC = Recurrent - Primary
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
)

# View top rows
head(limma_res)

# Optional: summary of significance
summary(limma_res$adj.P.Val)

```
```{r}
## Save limma results (paired DEGs) as CSV
outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

deg_file <- file.path(outdir, "GLASS_paired_DEGs_Recurrent_vs_Primary_WTGBM.csv")
write.csv(limma_res, deg_file, row.names = TRUE)

```


#### DEG visualizaiton

```{r}
## Paired slope plots for COL1A1 / COL1A2 / COL3A1 (GBM, IDH-wt only)

# Genes of interest
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

# 1) Extract voom log-expression for these genes
col_expr_mat <- v$E[rownames(v$E) %in% col_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# 2) Build long dataframe with sample + metadata
col_long <- col_expr_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -gene,
    names_to  = "sample_id",
    values_to = "expr"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_paired2 %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, patient, tumor_type),
    by = "sample_id"
  )

# Quick sanity check (optional)
# table(col_long$gene, col_long$tumor_type)

# 3) Paired slope plot with jittered points, faceted by gene
ggplot(col_long, aes(x = tumor_type, y = expr, group = patient)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
    size     = 1.8,
    alpha    = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Paired Primary → Recurrent Expression (COL1A1 / COL1A2 / COL3A1)\nGBM, IDH-wildtype",
    x     = "",
    y     = "voom log2 expression"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```

### Filter transcriptional subtype

```{r}
## Reload subtype file cleanly and compute best subtype per sample

sub <- read.delim(
  file.path(glass_dir, "analysis_transcriptional_subtypes.tsv"),

  group_by(aliquot_barcode) %>%

  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(aliquot_barcode, signature_name)
```

#### Subtype Switching

```{r}
## ==== CLEAN switch_df without slice(): one PRIMARY + one RECURRENT per patient ====

# One primary subtype per patient
primary_unique <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor_type == "Primary") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    primary_subtype = dplyr::first(signature_name),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# One recurrent subtype per patient
recurrent_unique <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(tumor_type == "Recurrent") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    recurrent_subtype = dplyr::first(signature_name),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Build clean switch_df (no duplicated patients)
switch_df <- primary_unique %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(recurrent_unique, by = "patient") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    switched = primary_subtype != recurrent_subtype,
    to_mes   = (primary_subtype != "Mesenchymal" &
                recurrent_subtype == "Mesenchymal")
  )

cat("Unique patients in switch_df:", nrow(switch_df), "\n")
any(duplicated(switch_df$patient))  # should be FALSE
```

```{r}
## ==== Pie charts for ALL subtypes (Primary vs Recurrent) using clean switch_df ====

outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

# 1) Convert switch_df to long format
pie_long <- switch_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(primary_subtype, recurrent_subtype),
    names_to  = "tumor_type",
    values_to = "subtype"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    tumor_type = ifelse(tumor_type == "primary_subtype", "Primary", "Recurrent"),
    tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent"))
  )

# 2) Count + percentage
pie_df <- pie_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(tumor_type, subtype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct   = 100 * n / sum(n),
    label = paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

cat("Counts used in pie chart (should be 68 per tumor_type):\n")
print(pie_df)

# ---- SAVE RAW DATA ----
write.csv(
  pie_df,
  file = file.path(outdir, "SubtypeDistribution_Primary_vs_Recurrent.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 3) Color palette
subtype_cols <- c(
  "Classical"   = "#2CA02C",
  "Proneural"   = "#1F78B4",
  "Mesenchymal" = "#9467BD"
)

# 4) Plot object
p_subtype <- ggplot(pie_df,
       aes(x = "", y = pct, fill = subtype)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~ tumor_type) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subtype_cols, name = "Subtype") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Subtype Distribution in Paired GBM IDH-wt Cohort",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

# ---- SAVE FIGURE ----
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, "SubtypeDistribution_Primary_vs_Recurrent.pdf"),
  plot = p_subtype,
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)

# Return the plot to screen
p_subtype

```


```{r}
## ==== Paired DEG: Primary vs Recurrent in the 68 subtype-defined patients ====

# 1) Build a sample-level metadata frame with EXACTLY one Primary and one Recurrent per patient
meta_deg <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(patient %in% switch_df$patient) %>%        # keep only the 68 patients in switch_df
  dplyr::group_by(patient, tumor_type) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%                                      # one sample per patient × tumor_type
  dplyr::ungroup()

cat("Patients in DEG set:", length(unique(meta_deg$patient)), "\n")
print(table(meta_deg$tumor_type))

# 2) Subset counts to these samples
counts_deg <- counts_gene_paired2[, meta_deg$sample_id]

# Align metadata order with count matrix
meta_deg <- meta_deg[match(colnames(counts_deg), meta_deg$sample_id), ]
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts_deg) == meta_deg$sample_id))

# 3) limma-voom paired design: Recurrent vs Primary
meta_deg <- meta_deg %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient    = factor(patient),
    tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent"))
  )

y_deg <- DGEList(counts = counts_deg)

keep_deg <- rowSums(y_deg$counts) >= 10
y_deg <- y_deg[keep_deg, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

y_deg <- calcNormFactors(y_deg)

design_deg <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor_type, data = meta_deg)

v_deg <- voom(y_deg, design_deg, plot = FALSE)
fit_deg <- lmFit(v_deg, design_deg)
fit_deg <- eBayes(fit_deg)

limma_deg_68 <- topTable(
  fit_deg,
  coef   = "tumor_typeRecurrent",   # Recurrent – Primary
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
)

# 4) Look at COL1A1 / COL1A2 / COL3A1 in this 68-patient paired DEG
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

col_limma_68 <- limma_deg_68 %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% col_genes)

cat("\nCOL genes in 68-patient paired DEG (Recurrent vs Primary):\n")
print(col_limma_68)

```

```{r}
## ==== Paired DEG: ONLY Classical/Proneural → Mesenchymal transitions ====

outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

# 1) Identify CP→MES patients

# 2) Build metadata (1 primary + 1 recurrent per CP→MES patient)
meta_cp_mes <- meta_paired2_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(patient %in% cp_mes_patients) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient, tumor_type) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%  
  dplyr::ungroup()

cat("Patients in CP→MES DEG set:", length(unique(meta_cp_mes$patient)), "\n")

# Ensure order matches
meta_cp_mes <- meta_cp_mes[match(colnames(counts_cp_mes), meta_cp_mes$sample_id), ]
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts_cp_mes) == meta_cp_mes$sample_id))

# 4) Paired limma-voom
meta_cp_mes <- meta_cp_mes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient    = factor(patient),
    tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent"))
  )

y_cp <- DGEList(counts = counts_cp_mes)

keep_cp <- rowSums(y_cp$counts) >= 10
y_cp <- y_cp[keep_cp, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

y_cp <- calcNormFactors(y_cp)

design_cp <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor_type, data = meta_cp_mes)

v_cp <- voom(y_cp, design_cp, plot = FALSE)
fit_cp <- lmFit(v_cp, design_cp)
fit_cp <- eBayes(fit_cp)

limma_cp_mes <- topTable(
  fit_cp,
  coef   = "tumor_typeRecurrent",
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
)

# ---- SAVE raw DEG table ----
write.csv(
  limma_cp_mes,
  file = file.path(outdir, "Paired_DEG_CP_to_MES_Recurrent_vs_Primary.csv"),
  row.names = TRUE
)

# 5) Extract collagen genes
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

col_cp_mes <- limma_cp_mes %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% col_genes)

cat("\nCOL genes in CP→MES paired DEG (Recurrent vs Primary):\n")
print(col_cp_mes)
```

```{r}
## ==== Heatmap: COL1A1/1A2/3A1 + Top 25 DEGs in CP→MES paired cohort ====

library(pheatmap)

outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

# 1) Define collagen genes
col_genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1")

# 2) Get top 25 DEGs by adjusted P-value (excluding the collagen genes)
deg_cp_tbl <- limma_cp_mes %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")

top25_genes <- deg_cp_tbl %>%
  dplyr::arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!gene %in% col_genes) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:25) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

# 3) Combine: 3 collagen + top 25 DEGs
genes_plot <- c(col_genes, top25_genes) %>% unique()
genes_plot <- genes_plot[genes_plot %in% rownames(v_cp$E)]

# 4) Order samples (Primary then Recurrent within each patient)
meta_cp_mes <- meta_cp_mes %>%
  dplyr::arrange(patient, tumor_type)

sample_order <- meta_cp_mes$sample_id

# 5) Expression matrix
heat_mat <- v_cp$E[genes_plot, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

# 6) Column annotation: tumor type + subtype + patient number
annot <- meta_cp_mes %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, patient, tumor_type, signature_name) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id")

# 7) annotation colors
subtype_cols <- c(
  "Classical"   = "#2CA02C",
  "Proneural"   = "#1F78B4",
  "Mesenchymal" = "#9467BD"
)

tumor_cols <- c(
  "Primary"   = "#BBBBBB",
  "Recurrent" = "#000000"
)

ann_colors <- list(
  tumor_type      = tumor_cols,
  signature_name  = subtype_cols
)

# 8) Build plot object (so we can save as PDF)
heatmap_obj <- pheatmap(
  heat_mat,
  annotation_col   = annot,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  cluster_rows     = TRUE,
  cluster_cols     = TRUE,
  scale            = "row",
  show_colnames    = FALSE,
  main             = "CP→MES Paired Cohort: COL Genes + Top 25 DEGs\n(voom log2 expression, row-scaled)",
  silent           = TRUE   # <-- allows saving later
)

# 9) Save as PDF
pdf(file.path(outdir, "Heatmap_CP_to_MES_COL_plus_Top25DEGs.pdf"),
    width = 8, height = 10)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(heatmap_obj$gtable)
dev.off()

# Display heatmap to screen
heatmap_obj

```

```{r}
  filename = file.path(outdir, "CP_to_MES_Paired_Collagen_SlopePlot.pdf"),
  plot = p_cp_slope,

  height = 4
)
```

## TGFB analysis

```{r}
## ==== Per-Gene Paired Stats + Individual Plots for TGF-β Genes (CP→MES cohort) ====

library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

tgfb_gene_set <- c(
  "TGFB1", "TGFB2", "TGFB3",
  "TGFBR1", "TGFBR2", "TGFBR3",
  "SMAD1", "SMAD2", "SMAD3", "SMAD4", "SMAD5", "SMAD6", "SMAD7", "SMAD9",
  "BAMBI", "SKIL", "LTBP1", "THBS1",
  "SNAI1", "SNAI2", "ZEB1", "ZEB2", "ACTA2",
  "IL6", "IL11", "CCN2", "PDGFB",
  "MYC", "JUNB", "ATF3", "COMP"
)

# 1) Only keep genes actually in the dataset
tgfb_available <- tgfb_gene_set[tgfb_gene_set %in% rownames(v_cp$E)]
cat("Genes found:", length(tgfb_available), "/", length(tgfb_gene_set), "\n")

# 2) Prepare output directory
outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GLSS/TGFB_single_plots"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

# 3) Loop through each gene
for (g in tgfb_available) {

  cat("\n====================\n")
  cat("Gene:", g, "\n")
  cat("====================\n")

  ## ---- Extract expression vector ----
  expr_vec <- v_cp$E[g, ]

  ## ---- Build design matrix for paired model ----
  meta_tmp <- meta_cp_mes %>%
    mutate(
      patient    = factor(patient),
      tumor_type = factor(tumor_type, levels = c("Primary", "Recurrent"))
    )

  design_tmp <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor_type, data = meta_tmp)

  fit_tmp <- lmFit(expr_vec, design_tmp)
  fit_tmp <- eBayes(fit_tmp)
  tt <- topTable(fit_tmp, coef = "tumor_typeRecurrent", number = 1)

  ## ---- Print stats for this gene ----
  print(tt %>% dplyr::select(logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val))

  ## ---- Build long-form for plotting ----
  df_plot <- data.frame(
    gene       = g,
    sample_id  = colnames(v_cp$E),
    expr       = expr_vec
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      meta_cp_mes %>% select(sample_id, patient, tumor_type, signature_name),
      by = "sample_id"
    )

  ## ---- Plot ----
  p_gene <- ggplot(df_plot,
                   aes(x = tumor_type, y = expr,
                       group = patient, color = signature_name)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
      size = 2, alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      Classical   = "#2CA02C",
      Proneural   = "#1F78B4",
      Mesenchymal = "#9467BD"
    )) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Paired Expression: ", g, " (CP→MES)"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "logFC = ", round(tt$logFC, 3),
        ", p = ", signif(tt$P.Value, 3),
        ", adj.p = ", signif(tt$adj.P.Val, 3)
      ),
      x = "",
      y = "voom log2 expression",
      color = "Subtype"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90")
    )

  ## ---- Save each gene's plot ----
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0("TGFB_", g, "_paired_plot.pdf")),
    plot = p_gene,
    width = 4,
    height = 4
  )

  ## ---- Print to screen ----
  print(p_gene)
}

```
